title: Skip cargo checks the change cannot affect
summary: Add an optional per-check `paths` list (globs/prefixes) to the check config. Athena skips a check when no changed path matches. A doc-only change then skips fmt, clippy and test. Skipped checks are recorded as "not run" and count as passed, like the nested-run case.

defaults_applied.how: Implemented in Rust in athena-data config and athena-core run; no non-Rust files added.
Unit tests for path matching and for the skip in the run loop; cargo test and clippy must pass.
The skip rule is configured in athena.toml and enforced in code, not prose.
One focused change to the check-selection step only.
Behavior criteria run cargo test and clippy; the skip logic is covered by tests.

assumptions: Mechanism: an optional `paths` filter on each check in athena.toml; with no filter a check always runs.
The cargo checks run when any changed path is *.rs, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml, rustfmt/clippy config, or lies under crates/ or xtask/. Other changes (e.g. *.md, docs/) skip them.
Conservative default: if the change list is empty or a path is unknown, run everything.
Skipped checks appear in the check records as passed with a 'not run: no changed path can affect it' note, reusing the nested-run skip shape.
The test check (kind=test) zero-test rule is unaffected because skipped checks are not run.
Both change and study capability check tables get the filter.
Include tests files (include_str!, CARGO build scripts, .github workflows are not cargo inputs) conservatively: any non-.md path outside docs/ counts as affecting.

acceptance_criteria.text: CheckConfig in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs has an optional `paths` field (default: always run), and CheckSpec carries it through both capabilities' checks().
athena.toml lists `paths` for the fmt, clippy and test checks of the change and study capabilities, so Rust, Cargo and toolchain files trigger them and docs-only changes do not.
The check loop in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs skips a check when no changed path matches, records it as passed with a 'not run' note, and runs every check when the change list is empty.
Run `cargo test --locked`: new tests pass showing a docs-only change list skips cargo checks, a .rs or Cargo.toml change runs them, and an unfiltered check always runs.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`: both clean.
athena.toml still parses under deny_unknown_fields, and a test loads the repo's athena.toml and checks the filters on the shipped checks.

out_of_scope: Skipping the verifier agent for doc-only jobs
Changing check timeouts or the CI workflow
Changing which checks exist or their commands
departures: Higher cost and time than the reference: this touches the config schema, two capabilities, the run loop, and athena.toml (governance), and needs new tests, so it is bigger than a typical job.
